blocks.text: Bacteria bohat ahem organisms hain, sirf mahol (environment) ke liye nahin balke baqi tamam jandaron ke liye bhi. Zameen par zindagi par in ke faidemand (beneficial) aur nuqsan-deh (harmful) dono tarah ke asraat hain.
Bacteria ki bohat si qismon mein se bohat se bacteria ecology (mahol) aur maeeshat (economy) dono lihaaz se faidemand hain.
Qudrat ke recyclers (dobara kaam mein lane wale)

Bacteria taqreeban tamam biogeochemical cycles mein hissa lete hain, jin mein zaroori elements (anasir) jandaron aur mahol ke darmiyan aate jaate rehte hain. Nitrifying bacteria (jo ammonia ko nitrite aur nitrate banate hain, jaise Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter) aur denitrifying bacteria (jaise Pseudomonas, jo nitrate ko wapas nitrogen gas banate hain) nitrogen cycle ko mukammal karne mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain. Decomposer bacteria (galane wale) murda organic maadde ko tor dete hain aur carbon-hydrogen-oxygen cycle mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain. Photosynthetic bacteria, jaise cyanobacteria, ki sargarmiyan zameen ki fiza mein azaad oxygen barhane mein kirdar ada karti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab nitrifying bacteria ki list mein Azotobacter ko bhi likhti hai. Azotobacter nitrifying nahin, balke nitrogen fix karne wala bacterium hai (kitab khud 2.6 mein ise nitrogen-fixing aerobic bacteria mein rakhti hai). Nitrifying bacteria Nitrosomonas aur Nitrobacter hain.

Bohat se bacteria, maslan Lactobacillus, yeasts aur molds (phaphoond) ke saath mil kar hazaron saal se fermented (khameer wali) khoraak banane mein istemal ho rahe hain, jaise cheese, achaar (pickles), soy sauce, sirka (vinegar), wine aur dahi (yogurt). Pharmaceutical (dawaiyon ki) aur agrochemical (zarai kemiyai) industry mein ahem chemicals banane ke liye bacteria sab se ahem hain. Kuch bacteria antibiotics banane mein istemal hote hain. Chamre (leather) ki cheezein banane ke liye janwaron ki khaal ki tijarati tayyari mein bhi bacteria istemal hote hain.

Bohat se bacteria organic compounds ko bohat aasani se tor dete hain. Aise bacteria mahol se pollutants (gandagi phailane wale maadde) hatane ya torne ke liye istemal kiye gaye hain; is ko bioremediation kehte hain. Maslan, bacteria shehr ke sewage (gande pani) ko be-zarar cheezon mein tor dete hain. Kuch bacteria petroleum mein maujood hydrocarbons ko hazam kar sakte hain. Yeh bacteria samundar mein phaile tel (oil spills) ko saaf karne ke liye istemal hote hain. Bacteria industry ke zehreelay fuzlay (toxic wastes) ki bioremediation ke liye bhi istemal hote hain.

blocks.title: Bioremediation
blocks.text: Zinda jandaron, yahan bacteria, ka istemal kar ke mahol se pollutants ko hatana ya be-zarar banana.

Biological pest control (keeron ko qudrati tareeqe se qaboo karna) mein pesticides (keeron ko maarne wali dawaiyon) ki jagah bacteria istemal kiye jate hain. Is mein aam tor par Bacillus thuringiensis istemal hota hai, jo ek Gram-positive, mitti mein rehne wala bacterium hai. Yeh biopesticides mahol dost hain aur insanon, jangli hayat (wildlife), pollinators (phoolon ka zardana le jane wale keeray) aur aksar doosre faidemand keeron par bohat kam ya bilkul asar nahin karte.

Bacteria tezi se barhte hain aur scientists un mein aasani se tabdeeli (manipulation) kar sakte hain. Inhi wajoohat se bacteria molecular biology, genetics aur biochemistry mein istemal hote hain. Scientists bacterial DNA mein mutations (tabdeeliyan) karte hain aur dekhte hain ke khoobiyon (characteristics) mein kya badla. Is tarah woh bacteria mein genes aur enzymes ka kaam maloom karte hain. Phir yeh ilm zyada complex (pecheeda) jandaron mein wohi genes aur enzymes samajhne ke liye istemal hota hai. Scientists insani genes bacteria mein daal kar ilaaj ke proteins bhi banate hain, jaise insulin, growth hormones ya antibodies.

blocks.prompt: Bacteria research ke liye itne mufeed auzaar kyun hain, aur bacteria mein insani gene daal kar kaunsi ek dawai wali cheez banai jati hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh tezi se barhte hain aur in mein aasani se tabdeeli ki ja sakti hai, is liye mutations kar ke genes aur enzymes ka kaam samjha ja sakta hai. Bacteria mein daale gaye insani genes se ilaaj ke proteins bante hain, jaise insulin, growth hormones ya antibodies.

items: Bacteria elements ko recycle karte hain: nitrifying aur denitrifying bacteria nitrogen cycle mukammal karte hain, decomposers carbon-hydrogen-oxygen cycle chalate hain, cyanobacteria oxygen barhate hain.
Yeh fermented khoraak, chemicals aur antibiotics banate hain aur chamre ki tayyari mein kaam aate hain.
Yeh sewage, oil spills aur zehreelay fuzlay ki bioremediation se mahol saaf karte hain.
Bacillus thuringiensis biopesticide ke tor par istemal hota hai.
Yeh molecular biology, genetics aur biochemistry ke auzaar hain, aur insani genes daal kar insulin jaise proteins banate hain.
